style.toneOfVoiceUnformatted: This Decoris hanging decoration is designed to add playful Christmas character to any tree. The wool mouse figures bring a cozy, handmade look that fits perfectly with classic festive décor. Assorted outfits in red, green, and white create a cheerful scene among branches and lights. On the Christmas tree, the soft mice stand out as charming little characters that complete a warm, wintry atmosphere. Handmade ornament made of soft wool.
